newsitem.title: UK: UK's Gardner says not interested in Mackie.
newsitem.headline: UK's Gardner says not interested in Mackie.

text.p: British engineering firm L Gardner Group Plc on Thursday denied a newspaper report that it was mulling a possible bid for Mackie International Group Plc.
The Belfast Telegraph quoted Gardner's non-executive chairman, Mike McDonald, as saying he was interested in buying Mackie.
But chief executive Roger Newton told Reuters that McDonald's interest had nothing to do with Gardner.
"He's an investor in his own right in various engineering concerns, and he's had some discussions with them," Newton said.
"We've made no approach to Mackie at all," he added. "You can never rule anything out, but at this point we are in no discussions and do not have any intention (of bidding for Mackie)."
Mackie's shares were suspended in April after the company announced that it might have to restate its accounts for 1996.
Gardner's shares stayed unchanged at 254p. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
